apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-server.ts.description: MCP tools use server.tool(name, description, zodSchema, handler) pattern with Zod schemas for input validation. Tools return CallToolResult objects. Rate limiting is implemented via RateLimiter class.

apps/frontend/src/renderer/stores/ideati.description: Zustand stores use create<Interface>((set) => ({...})) pattern. Export async helper functions outside the store. Setup IPC listeners in setupXxxListeners() functions that return cleanup function.

apps/frontend/src/shared/constants/ipc.t.description: IPC channels defined as const object IPC_CHANNELS with categorized channel names. Over 200 channels organized by feature area.
